---
name: Feature request / 功能建議
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for X Toolkit
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: []
---

## Is your feature related to a problem? / 這個功能要解決什麼問題？
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

## Proposed solution / 建議做法
Describe the feature or change you'd like, and where it should appear
(settings panel switch, per-post button, menu command, etc.).

## Alternatives considered / 其他方案

## Does it need a new permission? / 是否需要新權限？
- [ ] No new `@grant` / `@connect`
- [ ] Yes — which, and why:

## UI language / i18n impact / 多語言影響
If it adds user-facing text, it must be translated into all 9 supported
languages. List the strings you expect to add.

## Additional context / 補充說明
Screenshots, mockups, or links to the current X behaviour help a lot.
